mapper.sql: tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_company_id, consignee_company_id, booking_status, routing_case_number, route_version_no, current_status, status_basis_milestone_no, under_review_reason, original_eta, latest_eta, last_acquired_at, next_expected_at, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.tracking_record (tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_company_id, consignee_company_id, booking_status, routing_case_number, route_version_no, current_status, status_basis_milestone_no, under_review_reason, original_eta, latest_eta, last_acquired_at, next_expected_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{consigneeCompanyId}, #{bookingStatus}, #{routingCaseNumber}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{currentStatus}, #{statusBasisMilestoneNo}, #{underReviewReason}, #{originalEta}, #{latestEta}, #{lastAcquiredAt}, #{nextExpectedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking.tracking_record SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, status_basis_milestone_no = #{statusBasisMilestoneNo}, under_review_reason = #{underReviewReason}, latest_eta = #{latestEta}, last_acquired_at = #{lastAcquiredAt}, next_expected_at = #{nextExpectedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.milestone (tracking_number, milestone_no, kind, location_unlocode, occurred_at, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at, state, registered_by, registered_at, data_source_id, external_id, published_at, adopted_by, adopted_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{milestoneNo}, #{kind}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{occurredAt}, #{sourceKind}, #{sourceRef}, #{acquiredAt}, #{state}, #{registeredBy}, #{registeredAt}, #{dataSourceId}, #{externalId}, #{publishedAt}, #{adoptedBy}, #{adoptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking.milestone WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} AND milestone_no = #{milestoneNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.scheduled_leg (tracking_number, leg_no, voyage_number, load_unlocode, discharge_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{legNo}, #{voyageNumber}, #{loadUnlocode}, #{dischargeUnlocode}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tracking_number FROM tracking.tracking_record WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tracking_number, current_status, original_eta, latest_eta, last_acquired_at, next_expected_at, created_at FROM tracking.tracking_record WHERE shipper_company_id IN ORDER BY created_at DESC, tracking_number LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tracking_number, milestone_no, kind, location_unlocode, occurred_at, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at, state, registered_by, registered_at, data_source_id, external_id, published_at, adopted_by, adopted_at FROM tracking.milestone WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} ORDER BY milestone_no
